blogs.title: GLP‑1 Receptor Agonists Unmasked: First Report of Semaglutide‑Associated Immune‑Mediated Necrotising Myopathy
blogs.description: An overview of why this case matters for every clinician prescribing GLP‑1 agonists. It will outline the epidemiology of semaglutide use, known adverse effects, the emerging signal of muscle toxicity beyond simple loss of lean mass, and how applying WHO‑Uppsala causality criteria supports a probable drug‑induced autoimmune process.

blogs.title: Rhabdomyolysis or Autoimmune Necrotising Myopathy? A Practical Diagnostic Roadmap After GLP‑1 Therapy
blogs.description: Step‑by‑step guidance on distinguishing acute toxic rhabdomyolysis from immune‑mediated necrotising myopathy when a patient presents with CK elevation after a GLP‑1 agonist. The post highlights temporal CK patterns, symptom evolution, imaging clues, the role of early autoantibody testing versus repeat testing, and when to proceed directly to muscle biopsy.

blogs.title: Seronegative Immune‑Mediated Necrotising Myopathy: When Muscle Biopsy Takes Center Stage
blogs.description: A deep dive into diagnosing IMNM without detectable HMGCR or SRP antibodies. The article will dissect the histopathologic hallmarks seen in the case—macrophage infiltration (CD68), membrane attack complex deposition, sparse CD3 T cells—and explain how these findings differentiate IMNM from polymyositis or pure toxic injury.

blogs.title: Short‑Course Steroids plus IVIG for Drug‑Triggered IMNM: How Aggressive Early Therapy Leads to Rapid Recovery
blogs.description: An evidence‑based review of treatment strategies for acute immune‐mediated necrotising myopathy when an offending medication has been identified. It will outline dosing regimens used in the case (pulse methylprednisone followed by oral prednisone ≤ 1 mg/kg and a single 2 g/kg IVIG course), rationale for rapid tapering, monitoring parameters, and pitfalls of prolonged immunosuppression.

blogs.title: CK, AST/ALT, Troponin—and the Mystery Muscle Patient: Interpreting Multi‑Organ Lab Elevations in Myositis
blogs.description: Teaching clinicians how to untangle laboratory results that could stem from skeletal muscle injury versus hepatic or cardiac sources. The piece uses the patient’s elevated transaminases, modest troponin rise, and cardiac MRI findings to illustrate correlation with CK trends, imaging adjuncts, and when myocardial involvement should change management.

blogs.title: Pharmacovigilance in the Era of Obesity Therapeutics: Building Safe Prescribing Practices for Semaglutide
blogs.description: Practical recommendations for clinicians who start GLP‑1 agonists today—baseline CK screening in high‑risk patients (obesity with NAFLD or prior unexplained CK elevation), patient education on early muscle symptoms, systematic reporting pathways (FDA MedWatch, EudraVigilance), and how aggregated case reports can turn rare events into actionable safety signals.
